main.description: Insert a commit object. commitHash = sha256 over canonical-encoded {treeHash, parentHashes, authorDid, committerDid, message, timestamp}. Signature field is NOT included in the hash input so the same commit can be re-signed by key rotation without hash drift. Immutable once written.

parentHashes.description: 0 parents = root commit; 1 = normal; 2+ = merge. Order significant.

committerDid.description: Defaults to authorDid. Differs only for CI / bot commits pushed on behalf of a human author.

timestamp.description: Author timestamp. Server stamps committer timestamp independently.

signatureEs256.description: Base64url ES256 signature over commitHash by authorDid signing key (ADR-0010). Required; bootstrap literal 'bootstrap' accepted only for the very first commit of a freshly created DID.

errors.name: InvalidSignature
errors.description: ES256 signature does not verify against authorDid's signing key.
